approved_scope.title: Bug add leaves the session
acceptance_criteria: A bug added while a session is active, with or without --observation, records that session as its session key and leaves the session's record byte-identical; chough checkpoint and chough context list it after the bugs the checkpoint holds, the archived story names it, and a blocking one stops the session (#382, #395). Two branches that each add a bug in the same session merge without a conflict and the merged checkpoint lists both (#382). bug add takes about the same time at 400 observations as at 3 (#395), and with 200 bug links held it still files the bug in the session. A bug updated with --observation naming an entry of the active session joins its checkpoint unless it was filed in that session. A bug whose session key names an archived session or one that no longer exists is one of no open session's bugs: no checkpoint, context or blocking check lists it, and no command reports an error for it.

answers.constraints: The issues set the scope: #382 and #395 (tester2's 62-F6 and 62-F13), both from #343, which implemented Leif's auto-link decision for #329; this keeps that decision's outcomes (a bug filed in a session is the session's, its story names it, a blocking one stops it) and moves where the link is stored, which changes sentences he approved in REQ-cli-012 and REQ-cli-054, so it waits for his word. Rule 5: prefer a fix that removes a rule; this removes bug add's full-session refusal and adds none. DRIVE-12: no hand-resolved conflict in a file Chough writes. Older readers (v0.6.1 and main) read the new bug key. Based on main 056cbb80; no other open batch modifies these requirements. No new dependency. Failing tests first.
